import jsonl_changed as m

# Basic parsing, whitespace-only lines skipped
assert m.parse_jsonl('{"a":1}\n\n  \n{"b":2}\n') == [{"a":1}, {"b":2}]

# CRLF
assert m.parse_jsonl('{"a":1}\r\n{"b":2}\r\n') == [{"a":1}, {"b":2}]

# Final line without newline
assert m.parse_jsonl('{"a":1}\n{"b":2}') == [{"a":1}, {"b":2}]

# Empty / whitespace only
assert m.parse_jsonl('') == []
assert m.parse_jsonl('   \n\t\n') == []

# Malformed nonblank line raises ValueError
for bad in ['{bad}', '{"a":1,}', '[1,2', 'not json']:
    try:
        m.parse_jsonl(bad)
        raise AssertionError("expected ValueError for %r" % bad)
    except ValueError:
        pass

# Duplicate keys at top level
try:
    m.parse_jsonl('{"a":1,"a":2}')
    raise AssertionError("expected ValueError")
except ValueError:
    pass

# Duplicate keys at nested depth
try:
    m.parse_jsonl('{"x":{"y":1,"y":2}}')
    raise AssertionError("expected ValueError")
except ValueError:
    pass

# Duplicate keys in array elements
try:
    m.parse_jsonl('[{"a":1,"a":2}]')
    raise AssertionError("expected ValueError")
except ValueError:
    pass

# Non-object values still work
assert m.parse_jsonl('1\n"str"\ntrue\nnull\n[1,2,3]') == [1, "str", True, None, [1,2,3]]

# Valid duplicate-free nested object
assert m.parse_jsonl('{"a":{"b":1},"c":[{"d":2}]}') == [{"a":{"b":1},"c":[{"d":2}]}]

print("All checks passed.")
EOF
